newsitem.title: UK: Czech bank credit increased to $2 billion.
newsitem.headline: Czech bank credit increased to $2 billion.

text.p: LONDON, June 13 (LPC) - Czech National Bank arrangers Chase, Commerzbank, JP Morgan and SBC Warburg have announced that the one-year revolving credit for the Czech National Bank has been increased to $2 billion from the launch figure of $1.5 billion.
The deal was syndicated on a club basis and sold remarkably quickly -- the transaction was oversubscribed within a week of launching, bankers said.

The rarity of the transaction, which was sought to bolster currency reserves, proved attractive to lenders, which have few opportunities to book Czech sovereign risk, sources said. -- LPC Newsroom 44-0171-542-4048
